newsitem.title: UK: CYCLING-BOARDMAN BREAKS ONE HOUR WORLD RECORD.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-BOARDMAN BREAKS ONE HOUR WORLD RECORD.

text.p: Britain's Chris Boardman regained the one hour world record on Friday when he covered 56.3759 km on Manchester's indoor track.
Swiss Tony Rominger set the previous best of 55.291 km in Bordeaux, France in October 1994.
Boardman last achieved the one hour mark in July 1993 when he covered 52.270, also in Bordeaux.
In Manchester last week, the former Olympic champion twice set 4,000 metres world records on his way to the world pursuit championship.
